_about: Optimist class layer for the flags library. It never changes an RRS meaning. 'notes' adds a class note to a signal (texts in i18n flags.json -> classes.optimist.notes.<id>); 'si': true labels a note or an entry 'usually set by the sailing instructions'. 'add' adds entries (texts in classes.optimist.flags.<id>). 'hide' lists signal ids not shown for this class. Sources: IODA class rules (2020 edition + changes effective 2026-01-01, rule 4.2(a)); 2025 Optimist Asian & Oceanian Championship NoR; 2026 Australian Optimist Championship SIs; LRYC IODAI Connaughts 2023 regatta-fleet SIs. See .claude/memory/flags-sources.md.
